title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
source: Set 2 Source (unconfirmed): AKG CE-1 > UHER CR-40 (cassette master audience);

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience tape of a killer ’82 second set with a soaring Stella Blue, Let It Grow and a Casey Jones encore.
ai_review.review: The Uher‑240 audience recording is remarkably clear – listeners note “jaw‑dropping” fidelity despite some minor wind noise and upper‑mid harshness. Musically the show is described as one of the most memorable of ’82, with Jerry at his peak, relaxed yet high‑energy playing, and standout moments on Stella Blue, Let It Grow and a sweet Casey Jones encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently glowing comments about both the performance (exceptional second set, high energy) and the recording quality (excellent clarity, immersive), with only minor technical quibbles.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear and immersive Uher‑240 tape; occasional wind noise and slight burnt edges in the upper mids are noted but do not detract from overall clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is highlighted as a BAMF, flowing smoothly with relaxed yet high‑energy groove; the encore adds a sweet finish.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised as being at his best for ’82 and delivering top‑notch guitar work.
